subject: planner: TTL scan can trigger sync/async load/generateRuntimeFilter (#62616)
summary: Adds `SessionVars.InternalSQLScanUserTable` (set/reset by TTL scan sessions) and uses it to re-enable `CollectPredicateColumnsPoint` and `SyncWaitStatsLoadPoint` under `InRestrictedSQL`, so internal TTL scan SQL over user tables can trigger predicate-column collection plus sync/async stats/histogram load requests similarly to regular user SQL.
